text:
Maria (CS): quick heads up — onboarding SSO webhooks failing for ~12 tenants in eu-west-1, customers seeing 401 during auth handoff. blocked activations and a couple trial conversions at risk. drafting a customer note, need ops + eng confirmation on mitigation and ETA
Alex (Platform): on it, triaging identity stack now. any tenant list?
Maria (CS): @Noah shared the list in the ticket — I'll paste below for comms. priority: high-touch trial accounts first.
Noah (AM): confirmed list in support ticket #1423. mainly enterprise trials and a couple reseller onboarders. customers already flagged for renewal check-ins.
Sam (SRE): quick summary from logs: token validation failures after last identity-proxy rollout (v2.2.0). looks like a header parsing regression — proxy returning 401 to upstream. investigating rollback viability.
Alex (Platform): rollback path validated. plan: rollback identity-proxy to v2.1.3 in eu-west-1, start canary then full rollout. estimated mitigation start in ~8–12m, full fix within 25–35m if no surprises.
Maria (CS): ok pls confirm timeline and I'll send interim status to affected customers. Do we need legal review on wording?
Priya (Legal): short interim status ok — apologize, explain we're investigating and provide ETA + office hours invite. no deep technical blame. include contact alias and CC for high-touch accounts.
Maria (CS): drafting — please review quick snippet below and react with :thumbsup: if okay to send now to the affected list. will escalate edits after 10m.
Maria (CS): ```Hi — We're seeing an authentication issue affecting some onboarding flows in EU. Our engineers are actively investigating and expect a mitigation within ~30 minutes. If you're currently blocked, reply to this thread or join our troubleshooting office hours at 15:30 UTC (link). We apologize for the disruption — CS will follow up with a full update and remediation steps.```
Sam (SRE): looks good. add: "we will provide a targeted workaround for impacted customers if you need immediate re-onboarding" — ops can run manual reruns.
Alex (Platform): starting rollback now. command: `kubectl -n onboarding rollout undo deployment/identity-proxy --to-revision=3` — monitoring logs and health checks.
DeployBot: deployment "identity-proxy" rollback to v2.1.3 triggered by alex.platform at 1765439990. Watch: https://k8s.console/rollouts/identity-proxy
Sam (SRE): health checks passing on canary (2/2). rolling to remaining pods. will post green once completed.
Maria (CS): thanks. I'm sending the interim message to all affected customers and scheduling a 30-min office hours slot for targeted help. adding credit offer for trial tenants — propose 2 weeks free + dedicated enablement session.
Noah (AM): agree on credit for trial churn risk. please include a one-click calendar link for the enablement session. I'll follow up with any exec outreach.
Priya (Legal): credit offer OK. keep language conditional ("we will offer a credit if the disruption affected activation").
Sam (SRE): full rollout done, health stable, final verification on background jobs now. causal RCA: header parsing change in identity-proxy v2.2.0 causing token header to be dropped for a subset of requests. patch will be included in next release and we'll add integration test to cover the header case.
Maria (CS): sending full update + RCA note in 30m. action items for CS: 1) send interim now (done), 2) send follow-up RCA + remediation and credit details (in 30m), 3) schedule customer office hours and enablement handoffs, 4) capture feedback via short form and flag renewal-risk customers to AMs.
Alex (Platform): follow-ups for eng: add integration test, revert change in v2.2.1 candidate, create rollout guard for header-preserving config.
Sam (SRE): postmortem will include timeline, root cause, and mitigation checklist. tagging owners: alex.platform (fix), sam.sre (deploy), maria.cs (customer comms), noah.am (renewal outreach).
Maria (CS): thanks team — sending initial comm now and will post the RCA draft here in ~25m for sign-off. :white_check_mark:
